Researchers Min-Jun Chen and Henri Whitfield wanted to increase civic participation in two towns that historically had low volunteer rates. The team tested two new outreach methods that combined door-to-door visits with digital reminders. The highest percentage of residents who volunteered during the study was closest to ______
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement. The graph shows participation results for two new outreach methods tested in two towns, Ashford and Belmont. According to the graph, outreach method 2 produced the highest percentage of residents who volunteered: about 75% in Belmont.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because, according to the graph, the highest percentage of residents who volunteered was 75%, not 45%. None of the tests produced a volunteer rate of 45%.
